examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{落成|らくせい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{落成|らくせい}{式|しき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{来賓|らいひん}→来賓：28580_raihin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{招|まね}かれた→招く：02425_maneku⟧。
examples.english: Many guests were invited to the inauguration ceremony.

examples.japanese: ⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{落成|らくせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The completion of the library is scheduled for next spring.

notes:
Specifically refers to the completion of a building or large structure, often accompanied by a formal ceremony. Not used for completing tasks, projects, or abstract work.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {落成|らくせい}{式|しき}: inauguration ceremony, completion ceremony
- {落成|らくせい}⟦{披露|ひろう}→披露：09683_hirou⟧: unveiling of a completed building
- {落成|らくせい}⟦{記念|きねん}→記念：00232_kinen⟧: commemoration of building completion
- {落成|らくせい}⟦{祝|いわ}い→祝い：01838_iwai⟧: celebration of building completion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{完成|かんせい}→完成：01550_kansei⟧: completion — general-purpose; used for any project, work, or object, not limited to buildings
- ⟦{竣工|しゅんこう}→竣工：16491_shunkou⟧: completion of construction — technical term used in the construction industry, more formal than {落成|らくせい}
- ⟦{開業|かいぎょう}→開業：14570_kaigyou⟧: opening of business — focuses on starting operations rather than building completion
